note: The plain-language line of each counted change that has one, written 2026-10-22. A stand-in until the weekly feed carries a line for every change in changes[]; a change with no entry here shows its date and issuing body only.

FR-E01.text: state refocuses the project on a directory of recipients

FR-E10.text: format standard tightens invoice identifier and address checks

FR-E11.text: format standard expands guidance on e-invoice addresses

FR-E26.text: right to change platform created; the old platform serves at least a year

FR-E48.text: binding invoice formats written into law

FR-E49.text: platforms must follow the API and use-case standards

FR-E50.text: format conversion must keep a readable copy

FR-E51.text: duplicate invoice numbers must be caught by the platform

FR-E52.text: new mandatory data item: price uplift for fees and charges

FR-E53.text: two data-reporting start dates moved to 1 Sep 2026 and 1 Sep 2027

FR-E55.text: transaction reporting moves to fixed intervals, no longer a minimum

FR-E56.text: directory must list members of a VAT group

FR-E57.text: changing reception platform becomes a regulated procedure

FR-E24.text: the platform itself sends invoice, transaction and payment data to the tax administration

FR-E54.text: transaction and payment data sets change content

FR-E58.text: platform registration, audit and certification are tightened
